title: Sociology as an UPSC optional is easy subject but even after joining coaching I am facing difficulty to understand the content and am not able to build answers for Mains answer writing. This making me highly underconfident. How can I tackle this?
reason: The user is struggling with the transition from understanding content to building Mains answers in Sociology. Note [1] and [2] directly address answer writing frameworks and optional strategy, which are the exact pain points mentioned.

matched_note.title: UPSC CSE Mains Answer Writing Framework: Structure, Committee Quotes & Data Points

drafted_comment:
The real issue here is trying to write 'general' answers instead of 'structured' ones. Sociology requires you to move beyond just knowing the theory to applying it through a specific framework.

To fix this, try these three steps:

1. Use the 4-Anchor Formula: Every answer should have a clear Definition/Statute, 2-3 concrete dimensions, a specific Committee Quote (like 2nd ARC), and a forward-looking Way Forward.
2. Stop overthinking the content: Focus on mapping your points to the GS syllabus. If you can link a sociological concept to a current governance issue, you win.
3. Anchor with Data: Use hard statistics or specific committee recommendations to back your arguments. Evaluators reward named institutional facts over vague generalities.
